title: Combinatorial search and complexity
approval: Author-agent design review; not scientific acceptance or publication approval.

figures.title: Checking is not finding
figures.captionThesis: A verified path proves existence; a failed candidate does not prove absence.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Do not label rejected candidate as a no-instance.

figures.title: Merge prefixes only when the future agrees
figures.readerQuestion: Why can dynamic programming reuse work?
figures.mechanism: Map both histories to (S,v); extend by unused outgoing neighbors
figures.captionThesis: Existence of a completion depends on (S,v), not on the order already consumed.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: This state forgets counts, costs and molecular populations.

figures.title: A cycle becomes a fixed-endpoint path
figures.mechanism: Split the pivot, open the cycle, then identify endpoints in reverse
figures.captionThesis: Both directions preserve existence and the transformation is polynomial.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: The transformation does not solve either problem.

figures.title: A path as a Boolean assignment
figures.readerQuestion: What must the SAT encoding forbid?
figures.mechanism: Choose one vertex per slot and one slot per vertex; impose endpoints and legal adjacency
figures.captionThesis: Satisfying assignments and fixed-endpoint paths correspond exactly.
figures.evidenceSource: Original CNF encoding and exhaustive tests
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Reducing Hamiltonian path to SAT alone does not prove Hamiltonian path hard.

figures.title: Bits, vertices and reagent copies
figures.mechanism: Count representation symbols before reporting a time bound
figures.captionThesis: Polynomial in numeric value can be exponential in its bit length.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Encoding choices and physical material are not interchangeable.

figures.title: Recovering a witness with decision queries
figures.readerQuestion: How can yes/no answers guide construction?
figures.mechanism: Replay six ordered trial deletions from the original six-edge graph; retain a yes-instance after every trial; reconstruct the final path
figures.captionThesis: At most m+1 oracle queries suffice for this search reduction.
figures.evidenceSource: Original edge-deletion proof and exhaustive small tests
figures.misleadingInterpretation: The oracle is not free and not implemented in polynomial time here.

figures.title: P, NP and coNP: track the quantifier
figures.mechanism: Negate existence, not a single verification result
figures.captionThesis: Polynomial verification of yes certificates does not supply no certificates.
figures.evidenceSource: MIT lecture 14; Toronto CS 2401 lecture 3 section 4; explicit complement-closure derivation
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Do not draw P as a proven strict subset of NP.

figures.title: Factorial enumeration versus subset states
figures.readerQuestion: What changes when histories are merged?
figures.mechanism: Compare explicit algorithmic counts on the same instances
figures.captionThesis: An exponential algorithm can improve on factorial enumeration without becoming polynomial.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Operational counters are not wall-clock benchmarks.

figures.title: Small depth can hide large work
figures.readerQuestion: Where did the search cost go?
figures.mechanism: Expose simultaneous branches and their total allocation
figures.captionThesis: Parallel depth is only one resource coordinate.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Do not equate Boolean circuit depth to laboratory time.

figures.title: No signal is not a universal negative
figures.mechanism: Trace the alternative causes of absence
figures.captionThesis: A missing signal needs coverage, retention and readout assumptions.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: This is not a calibrated experimental error probability.

figures.title: Reduction claims have three proof obligations
figures.mechanism: Check size then both implication directions
figures.captionThesis: A plausible drawing is not a reduction proof.
figures.evidenceSource: Original checklist tied to worked construction
figures.misleadingInterpretation: Testing finite cases cannot replace proof.

figures.title: From complexity back to molecules
figures.readerQuestion: What will the next chapter add?
figures.mechanism: Carry logical invariants into physical budgets
figures.captionThesis: Computational hardness and engineering feasibility answer different questions.
figures.misleadingInterpretation: No new universal molecular lower bound is asserted.
